messages:
maya: Quick huddle 1 I want final hero copy + two CTAs for Hosted, Dedicated, Private pages. Launch next Monday.
jonas: I can draft Hosted. Focus: developer velocity + predictable latency. Keep it pithy.
sara: Layout: hero line, one-line subhead, then three short micro-benefits under it. Visuals should be neutral for enterprise buyers.
kevin: Product callouts: Dedicated must mention SLA, reserved capacity, and burst. Private needs VPC/KMS and on-prem/air-gapped options.
maya: I tried three short hero variants per page below 1 pick favorites and I'll clean up tone.
maya: HOSTED HERO OPTIONS:
1) "Deploy LLMs fast. Ship features faster." 1 sub: "Hosted API with low latency, streaming, and usage controls."
2) "A developer API for production-grade inference." 1 sub: "Start with examples, scale with predictable performance."
3) "High-throughput inference, zero infra maintenance." 1 sub: "Transparent perf and cost breakdowns for every route."
jonas: Option 1 is momentum-y and dev-friendly. Option 2 reads trustworthy. 3 calls out ops value.
kevin: Hosted CTAs: primary: "Start free" secondary: "View benchmarks". Also add small link to docs.
sara: We'll use primary button color for Start free and outline for benchmarks. Place token-cost mini chart below the fold.
maya: DEDICATED HERO OPTIONS:
A) "Reserved capacity for mission-critical LLMs." 1 sub: "Single-tenant GPU pools, SLA, and enterprise controls."
B) "Throughput you can predict, latency you can guarantee." 1 sub: "Autoscale, burst, and policy-based routing."
jonas: A speaks enterprise. B is more technical. Lean A on marketing page.
kevin: Add hero badge line: "SLA / Reserved capacity / Enterprise support" and a small sizing toggle (4 / 16 / custom GPUs).
sara: We'll include a partner logos strip under hero and a quick ROI blurb.
maya: PRIVATE HERO OPTIONS:
i) "Run Redwood in your VPC or on-premise." 1 sub: "Customer-managed keys, audit log, and air-gapped install."
ii) "Private deployments for compliance-first workloads." 1 sub: "Full control over data, networking, and secrets."
kevin: Use i) for the public site, ii) for the sales one-pager. Also include: "API-compatible with Hosted" so customers know migration is easy.
jonas: Good point 1 short line: "Same API as Hosted 1 no lock-in" maybe too brash, suggest "Same API surface as Hosted for easy migration."
maya: Copy checklist: 1) choose one hero per page, 2) confirm 2 CTAs (trial/contact-sales/docs), 3) approve micro-benefits lists.
kevin: CTAs recommended: Hosted ["Start free","Benchmarks"], Dedicated ["Contact sales","Estimate capacity"], Private ["Contact sales","Request security brief"].
sara: Micro-benefits (wording): Hosted 1 "Low latency","Streaming & function calls","Cost breakdowns"; Dedicated 1 "Reserved GPU pools","SLA","Autoscale + burst"; Private 1 "VPC & KMS","Air-gapped option","Enterprise support".
jonas: Approve those micro-benefits. Also add one sentence on model compatibility and quantization support for infra audiences.
maya: I'll wire the copy into the CMS and add hero image suggestions. @sara please drop screenshots into #design; need visual sign-off by COB tomorrow.
ops-bot: Heads up: marketing site deploy scheduled for 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC.
maya: Thanks everyone 1 thumbs up when you approve. :thumbsup:
